snippet.title: The Deadseat - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667230/The_Deadseat/

THE DEADSEAT is a short horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home. Slowly, bits of your game begin to leak into reality, threatening everything you are. The game dives deep into themes of escapism, and rough childhood.

CHECK OUT OUR PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/CuriousFoxSox
JOIN OUR DISCORD: https://discord.gg/hnAY7DGPcS
